effect_text: Fire tiles you lay erupt 1 turn later: 3 damage per fire point to everyone on the tile and its neighbours, then the tile goes neutral.
Fire tiles you lay last 1 turn longer before they start to cool.
Your fire casts push the tile 1 extra step hotter (still capped at +3).
Take 15% less fire damage and half damage from burning tiles.
notes: Works whatever the wearer's own elements are

effect_text: Every tile you leave while moving gains 1 fire step.
+1 strength per fire point on the tile you stand on.
Your water casts also lay 1 water step on the ring of tiles around the target.
When you are struck, the attacker's tile gains 1 water step (primed for thunder).
Water tiles never slow you.
Water tiles you lay last 1 turn longer.
+1 dexterity per water point on the tile you stand on.
Your water tiles are 50% stronger: wading costs more and thunder gets +50% of the water bonus when it detonates them.
Water tiles you lay erupt 1 turn later: 1 damage per water point, everyone on the tile is pushed 1 hex out, and the tile keeps its water.
Your ice locks (glazes) last 1 turn longer.
Your ice also locks the 6 tiles around the one you target.
+2 defense while you stand on a locked (glazed) tile.
When thunder shatters a lock you made, the shatter multiplier is x2 instead of x1.5.
notes: 1.5 x 1.33 = 2.0. Depends on ELEMENTS.md keeping a glaze multiplier

effect_text: Your basic attacks have a 50% chance to lock the target's tile.
notes: On an empty tile this arms ice's marker instead (V8 Stasis)

effect_text: Your thunder effects trigger twice; the second resolves at 50%.
notes: Brief example (thundering full helm). 50% on the echo is my number; the brief says 'twice'

effect_text: Your detonations splash 2 rings out instead of 1.
Your thunder deals 20% more damage.
Take 25% less thunder damage and half damage from detonations you stand in.
Your detonations knock whoever stands on the tile 1 hex away from you.
When an adjacent enemy strikes you, thunder lands on its tile (detonating any charge there).
Your gales copy the tile 2 rings out instead of 1.
Your gales push everyone on the spread tiles 1 hex outward.
Tiles copied by your gales last 1 turn longer.
+1 extra wind affinity point every time you use wind.
Take 25% less wind damage.
Dark tiles you lay last 1 turn longer.
+1 speed per dark point on the tile you stand on.
Your dark casts push the tile 1 extra step darker (still capped at -3).
Every tile you leave while moving gains 1 dark step.
Your dark tiles hide their occupant 50% better.
Take 15% less dark damage.
Dark tiles you lay collapse 1 turn later: 2 damage per dark point to the occupant, and neighbours are pulled 1 hex in.
Your light tiles are 50% stronger: more healing and more exposure.
Light tiles you lay last 1 turn longer.
Your light casts push the tile 1 extra step brighter (still capped at +3).
When you are struck, the attacker's tile gains 1 light step (exposing it).
+1 willpower per light point on the tile you stand on.

Basic attacks and AoE skills reach 1 ring further. Allies in the added ring are spared.
Basic attack range is doubled.
Fires 3 shots along 3 different lines, 50% damage each.
Every basic attack hits twice at 75% damage each.
notes: Brief example (doubleshot longbow; there is no longbow, so recurve/compound). Each hit rolls separately

effect_text: After attacking you may move up to 2 more hexes, even if you moved before attacking.
notes: Brief example (flowing lance). Base rules already allow act-then-move, so this is a second move

effect_text: Basic attacks knock the target 1 hex straight back.
Basic attacks drag the target 1 hex toward you.
Once per enemy turn, when an adjacent enemy attacks you, strike back for 50%.
+10% critical chance.
Critical hits deal x2 instead of x1.5.
Attacks ignore 25% of the target's defense.
+10% damage for each hex moved this turn before attacking, up to +40%.
+2 range.
Weapon skills recover 1 turn faster.

effect_text: Basic attack can be thrown up to 2 extra hexes away for 75% damage.
notes: dmg_pct applies only beyond the weapon's normal range

effect_text: After you attack, take 25% less damage until your next turn.
+25% damage against targets standing on charged tiles.

notes: First hit is full damage; dmg_pct applies to the unit behind

effect_text: Spell AoEs reach 1 ring further (basic attack unchanged).
notes: Staff skills are not written yet; this rides on whatever AoE they have

effect_text: Flurry lands 4 strikes instead of 3.
notes: Rides multi_hit with skill=flurry: the basic attack ignores the row. Each strike stays at Flurry's 45%

effect_text: Uppercut knocks the target 2 hexes back instead of 1 (and slams if anything stops it on the way).
notes: on=skill keeps it off basic attacks; hexes add to Uppercut's own 1
